szoveg_eredeti:
We’re sharing new research demonstrating how AI agents can accelerate cryptanalysis - the science of stress-testing encryption. 🔒

Guided by humans, our models uncovered two major weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA cryptosystems.

While modern 2048-bit systems remain safe from these specific exploits, this work highlights a key shift.

As we enter a new era of AI-enabled math and computation, we can no longer rely on historical hardness assumptions and must continuously stress-test cryptographic standards. Our VP Science Pushmeet Kohli explains more ↓ https://lnkd.in/eKU6VKMp
